svg.aria-label: Left: Thomas Young, An Essay on the Cohesion of Fluids (1805), excerpt from p. 66; public-domain scan archived by Wikimedia Commons. The passage connects each solid–liquid combination with contact angle. Right: original interfacial-contribution diagram, with θ measured through liquid; arrow lengths do not represent force magnitudes.
